limitations: TIMS_2301.7z (25.1 GB) holds 14 Bruker .d folders (runs 1-9, 17, 19, 20, 21, 23); listing obtained from the 7z header via HTTP range, only these are claimed. Runs 10-16, 18, 22 and 24 exist only as derived .mgf (24 files) / .mzXML (23 files) and in the PEAKS search (24 spectra files) and are not claimed as raw runs.

Mapping of runs to the 7 participants and to pre-/post-exercise is not in any deposited file or the paper text read; treatment, sampling time, individual and age are therefore `not available`, no factor value was added, and biological replicate is 1 for every row only because the column is required (pre/post pairs from one person are not independent replicates).
Paper Table 1 lists 15 participants but only 7 were analysed by MS and which ones is not stated, so per-run age cannot be assigned.

RAW headers could not be read by range (files are inside a solid LZMA 7z); instrument, dissociation and collision energy were not verified from analysis.tdf and rely on protocol text. Dissociation method left `not available`.

Enzyme conflict: paper/PRIDE text says trypsin with no proline restriction, the deposited mzid/pepXML encode trypsin with the P restriction; Trypsin (MS:1001251) used per deposited search. N-terminal acetylation recorded as Any N-term per mzid; PRIDE text says protein N-term.
Templates: ms-proteomics + human. Disease value 'healthy' taken from the description wording (no ontology term lookup performed beyond parse_sdrf).
